components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clearly-lit action — starlight gradient with accent glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #fff; border: none; cursor: pointer; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-starlight-core), var(--color-starlight-deep)); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px oklch(0.5 0.13 255 / 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px oklch(0.5 0.13 255 / 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.2); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised surface with a hairline that brightens to starlight on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink); background-color: var(--color-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--color-starlight); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Text-only starlight action for tertiary links.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-starlight); background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The mono 'coordinate' that announces a section, with a single starlight point.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-starlight); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--color-starlight); }

narrative.overview: The site is a quiet star chart of shipped work — a deep, deliberate field of space-blue where each project is a charted point of light you can navigate to. The register is that of an observatory or a star atlas: precise, calm, meticulously labelled, and confident enough to leave large stretches empty. It serves two travellers at once — a recruiter scanning for the brightest points (projects, contact) and a lay visitor pulled straight into a live app. Wayfinding is the whole point, so nothing may bury the work: hierarchy stays loud even when the surface is quiet. Personality lives in restraint and a few authored details (mono labelling, a faint starfield, one nebula accent used almost never), never in effects for their own sake.
keyCharacteristics: Deep space-blue field (not black), lit by sparse starlight-blue accents.
Restrained color: one accent voice, warm accents reserved for near-nothing.
Monospace labelling as connective tissue — coordinates, metadata, section tags.
Generous void; large type; a strong, scannable hierarchy.
Calm, orchestrated motion; a faint ambient starfield, nothing that competes with reading.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Starlight is the only accent that appears freely, and even it covers ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes it read as light.

rules.name: The Two-Sparks Rule
rules.body: Nebula and Ember never appear together in the same viewport, and each appears at most once.

rules.name: The Deep-Blue-Not-Black Rule
rules.body: The ground is always Void (space-blue), never #000. Pure black is the generic-dark-UI tell we are avoiding.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Every section is announced by a small uppercase mono label (a 'coordinate'), not by a large word. The mono line orients; the display line states.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lit Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and borderless-soft at rest. Depth appears as tonal step or accent glow, never as a gray box-shadow.

dos: Do keep the ground Void (oklch(0.16 0.02 260)), never #000.
Do announce sections with a small uppercase mono label above the heading.
Do keep Starlight to ≤10% of any screen and reserve Nebula/Ember for at most one moment per page.
Do build depth from tonal steps and low-alpha white borders; use glow (colored) instead of gray drop-shadows.
Do keep projects and contact reachable within one viewport-scan.
Do cap reading measure at 65–75ch and leave generous void between sections.
Do disable the starfield and non-essential motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and keep AA contrast on Void.
donts: Don't ship the near-black + single-neon-accent + glowing-edges look.
Don't let motion or the starfield compete with reading.
Don't use pure white (#fff) for body text; use Ink (oklch(0.92 0.01 260)).
Don't introduce a second free accent hue; Starlight is the only voice.
Don't hardcode colors in components — reference tokens.
Don't crowd the surface; if a section feels dense, remove, don't shrink.
